edges.label: the largest operator of the one acquisition form built to be non-competitive by design
edges.note: MITRE operates multiple FFRDCs. FAR 35.017 permits an agency to meet special long-term research needs through a sponsoring agreement with a single operator outside full and open competition, and obliges the FFRDC to disclose its activities to its sponsor and to no one else. That is a contracting mechanism, and MITRE is its largest single instance.
